news.title: Why does Trump want to transfer Cold War-era plutonium to nuclear start-ups?
news.summary: The Trump administration has announced that it has selected several nuclear start-ups to participate in a project that would allow them to use plutonium stockpiles inherited from the Cold War. This plan has alarmed nuclear non-proliferation specialists.
news.source: France 24 - International breaking news, top stories and headlines
